content: SQLite corruption: PRAGMA integrity_check walks the whole file and returns the single word 'ok' when healthy; PRAGMA quick_check is the cheaper variant that skips index cross-checks. Corruption in place is not reliably repairable — the sanctioned response is restore-from-backup or sqlite3 .recover (3.29.0+), which salvages every readable page; a truncated file recovers only up to the truncation point. Always re-run integrity_check on the rebuilt file. Common causes for a desktop daemon: interrupted write, power loss during fsync, copying a live database, and a truncated/partially overwritten file.
